scientific_question: Does the remaining one-byte polar carry error come from the false independence assumption between update angle and magnitude?

causal_basis.observation: Shared polar coding is the strongest tested one-byte carry topology but misses its step-8 codec gate; learned additive RVQ is worse because greedy alternating assignment does not stably occupy its nominal 256 sums.
causal_basis.mechanism: Retain exact 32-way angular assignment, but condition the eight learned radial levels on the selected angular sector. This models p(r|phi) directly instead of imposing one global radial marginal.
causal_basis.rate_distortion_authorization: Observed shared-polar distortion remains far above the idealized eight-bit two-dimensional rate-distortion floor, so topology and conditional allocation should be tested before increasing bit rate.
